name: Immersion v1.4
body:
## ✨ Changelog

- Fixed stealth action bar disappearing after exiting stealth  
- Fixed black background issue on action bar after exiting stealth  
- Restored Dragonflight UI button backgrounds correctly  
- Reduced flickering with improved timing (`0.01s` + conditional second pass)  
- Improved compatibility with Dragonflight UI Reforged
